_comment: The work of this age that is not one occupation's own (each occupation's tasks and recipes are in its file in occupations/). 'tasks' with 'offices' are the work of those offices' holders; 'any_office': the work of any office with none of its own; tasks with neither are open to anyone. 'site_kinds': the kinds of good places that can be found or made (a task's 'site' names one). 'stock_targets': how much of each thing the society likes to hold (NPCs work toward it; 'food' and 'water' are points, the rest counts of items). 'craft_speed_tools': tools that make every recipe go that many times faster. The numbers behind trips, finds, the fire and yields are in data/rules/work.json.

lead_ritual.label: Lead a ritual of comfort
lead_ritual._comment: The Spirit Keeper's work: while it lasts everyone's Comfort rises faster and the tribe's care and culture count more (society.json).

office_duties.label: Attend to office duties
office_duties._comment: The work of any office that has no task of its own (Clan Leader, Chieftain...).

carry_off_dead.label: Carry the dead away from camp
carry_off_dead.done_text: carries {body} far from camp and covers the body with stones

burn_dead.label: Burn the dead on a pyre
burn_dead.done_text: builds a pyre and burns {body}'s body
